subject.title: [Bug]: Runtime tool surface returns blank body after gateway-touching operations; container restart only briefly clears it

question: Should maintainers treat this as a live source-isolation target for the broader gateway/session wedge, or route it only through the narrower tool-result projection PR?
rationale: The issue now has multiple credible reproductions, but current main does not prove a single owner path and the linked PR only partially overlaps the reported all-tools blank-body behavior.

options.title: Source-isolate the broad wedge
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical live repro target, collect raw logs/session evidence, and decide the fix after the gateway/session/tool owner path is identified.

options.title: Test the projection PR first
options.body: Ask reporters to try the open prompt-projection PR as a candidate mitigation while keeping this issue open until the broader gateway restart/compaction wedge is proven fixed.

options.title: Split recovery UX separately
options.body: Track a model-callable reset or tools_status surface separately if maintainers want self-rescue in addition to repairing the root cause.

recommendation.title: Source-isolate the broad wedge
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical live repro target, collect raw logs/session evidence, and decide the fix after the gateway/session/tool owner path is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent session-lock and tool-result work is adjacent to the highest-risk runtime surfaces, and they are the best available routing candidate from the history reviewed.
